Package com.datastax.dse.driver.api.querybuilder.schema Description

This package effectively mirrors the Cassandra OSS Schema interfaces to allow extended schema and query building for the DSE driver. NOTE: Changes made to the OSS driver will need to be mirrored here if the OSS driver changes affect an extended schema build strategy for the DSE driver.
